subject: general
question: Which of the following is correctly classified as a basic industry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aluminium smelting**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Aluminium smelting** is classified as a **basic industry**, as it provides essential raw materials for various other industries such as construction, transportation, electrical, and packaging.
 
• It involves the extraction of aluminium metal from its oxide, alumina, using a process called **electrolytic reduction**. This makes it a fundamental industrial process with widespread applications.
 
• Aluminium is a highly versatile and lightweight metal with **high corrosion resistance**, making it indispensable in manufacturing and engineering sectors.
 
• This industry contributes significantly to the **economic development** of a country by supporting downstream industries and creating employment opportunities.
 
• Aluminium smelting is energy-intensive and requires access to **abundant power resources**, which has led to its classification as a basic industry, similar to steel and cement.
